role: The hand-labelled cases the scope-read control half's answer rule is bounded by. Each case is graded by graders/scope_read.py on the control half; the hand label is what a reader of the reply decides.
not_a_claim: A case records how a reply reads under the rule, never how a model behaves; round 1's labels beside round 2's are in verification/round1-regrade/scope-read-control.json.
binding: round-1 replies name their take by the half they came from, model and take number, bound to the sha256 of the text after the probe and read from round 1's committed transcripts at test time. Synthetic cases carry their text and any tool calls. The eight walk messages are held in cases/scope-read.json, whose control labels CaseSuites keeps.
